snippet.title: Fleshchild - Visi - Night 01: A Presence of Mind
snippet.description:
This is the RPG maker game, Fleshchild by Bleet. This is a fangame that is heavily inspired by the RPG Maker game called Yume Nikki created by Kikiyama.

I've chosen the female brain to play as the female character named Visi.

Download link, wiki page and text walkthrough: https://yumenikkifg.fandom.com/wiki/Fleshchild

https://rpgmaker.net/games/9308/
